title: Print a greeting
summary: Rust: Print a greeting. Change the greeting.
introduction: println! prints text and starts a new line. main is the program entry point.

blocks.text: Install stable Rust. Save each example as lesson.rs, run rustc lesson.rs, then run the created program.
main starts the program. println! writes the string and adds a newline.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: println! has an exclamation mark because it is a macro.
